description: This file defines an object 'ScorePrefs' for managing game score persistence using Android's SharedPreferences, including methods to get, increment, and reset scoreboard counts for X wins, O wins, and draws.

methods.name: prefs
methods.description: Returns the SharedPreferences instance with the name 'ttt_scoreboard' for the given context.

methods.name: getXWins
methods.description: Retrieves the number of times X has won from preferences.

methods.name: getOWins
methods.description: Retrieves the number of times O has won from preferences.

methods.name: getDraws
methods.description: Retrieves the number of draws from preferences.

methods.name: incrementXWins
methods.description: Increments the X wins count by one and saves it.

methods.name: incrementOWins
methods.description: Increments the O wins count by one and saves it.

methods.name: incrementDraws
methods.description: Increments the draws count by one and saves it.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all scores for X wins, O wins, and draws to zero.
